g.title: E-18-light — Experiment Card versions (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/cards/card_experiment_01 · ?view=versions&version=v3 · Card version history distinct from run lifecycle: status, author, definition change, target/default diffs, direct version selection

g.text: card_experiment_01 · apiVersion wyrd/v1 · read-only projection of server truth
Versions are new immutable declarations of the grouping/comparison definition.
Selecting a row loads that declaration; runs stay associated with the exact version
Added the agent-assisted review workflow to the study:
runs recorded against v3: run_01 – run_06
runs recorded against v4: run_07 – run_12
Run lifecycle transitions — queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled — and newly arriving
outputs never create or mutate an Experiment Card version. v1–v4 exist only because a person changed the declaration.
